description: Shows what the big wallets are doing with a token. Reads onchain flows through NOWNodes: large transfers tagged with exchange names, net flows onto or off exchanges compared with the token's own 7-day pattern, exchange reserve trends and, live from the chain, who the biggest unlabelled wallets are. Returns ACCUMULATING, DISTRIBUTING or NEUTRAL with the moves behind it. Returns one of: ACCUMULATING / DISTRIBUTING / NEUTRAL / NO_DATA, with a plain summary, structured result, sourced reasons and a proof id. Price: 5 tADA on testnet (premium).

token.description: Token: CoinGecko id (chainlink), symbol (LINK) or contract address
